name: kolu-conductor
//dependencies: `@kolu/padi-client` is reached for a terminal's record TYPE and, at its `/attention` leaf, for the one fold that says what padi's urgency id lists MEAN (`frameByClass`/`frameClassOf`) — which the watch's readings (`src/readings.ts`) switch on. Re-declaring a parallel record shape or re-indexing those lists here would be a second answer to what padi already says, and the first one to go stale. `kolu-mcp` is reached ONLY at its `/fleetRef` leaf, the one definition of the `host/id` grammar every watched terminal is named in; that subpath deliberately carries no MCP SDK and no padi-client, which is why the same import is what `@kolu/acp-harness` takes.
//scripts: Its own unit lane holds only the PURE modules — the held queue, the watch list's wake decisions, the wake's account (`watching.test.ts`) — which need no door to be exercised. The Conductor's COMPOSITION suites — the host against the real fleet MCP door and the real tool registry — stay with the composition root in `packages/server`: stubbing the door to move them is exactly the drift one of those tests was written to stop (an imitation answered 400, the proof passed on it, and a door that could serve nobody looked healthy).
